baseline_rule: latest complete positive-total measured observation at or before the pulse
density_estimator: species median of positive finite pre-pulse cellular quota divided by measured cell volume
primary_scenario_scope: midpoint is a prespecified representative conversion, not an inferred species mixture; endpoints rerun calibration, forecasts and evaluation
primary_score: equal-vessel mean of time-weighted resource-share total variation on shared adjacent observation support
secondary_scores: exact pooled observed-profile TV envelopes against frozen nominal forecasts
recovery_scope: exploratory observed return to the pre-pulse resource composition after an observed departure; not population equivalence, return of absolute stocks or logarithmic neutrality
formal_neutrality_reason: Three partly pooled atomic groups do not establish a broad logarithmic size spectrum or independently justified interval weights
uncertainty_scope: descriptive whole-vessel scores and pooled-quota sensitivities; no uncalibrated bootstrap or population neutrality confidence claims
analysis_separation: retrospective development/evaluation partition; published summaries and methods were read; original bundle may contain all outcome bytes before forecast freeze, but held-out post-pulse numerical extraction/evaluation is gated on freeze
